import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.feature_selection import mutual_info_classif
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Identify potential drivers using t-test and AUC
    drivers = []
    scores = []
    
    # Filter for strong features (p < 0.01, |t| > 5)
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        t_stat = feats.types[i]  # placeholder for actual t-statistic
        if 'expression' in feats.types[i] or 'clinical' in feats.types[i]:
            # Use mean difference and t-statistic to rank
            mean_diff = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, i]) - np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, i])
            t_stat = abs(mean_diff) / (np.std(feats.x[:, i]) + 1e-8)
            if t_stat > 5:
                drivers.append((fid, t_stat))
    
    # Sort by t-statistic descending
    drivers.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
    drivers = [d[0] for d in drivers[:MAX_DRIVERS]]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    keep = []
    for i, d1 in enumerate(drivers):
        is_dup = False
        for j, d2 in enumerate(keep):
            if i != j:
                col1 = feats.column(d1)
                col2 = feats.column(d2)
                corr = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, col1], feats.x[:, col2])[0, 1]
                if abs(corr) > 0.6:
                    is_dup = True
                    break
        if not is_dup:
            keep.append(d1)
    
    drivers = keep
    
    # Build columns list using all features with strong effect
    columns = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        if feats.types[i] in ['expression', 'clinical']:
            mean_diff = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, i]) - np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, i])
            t_stat = abs(mean_diff) / (np.std(feats.x[:, i]) + 1e-8)
            if t_stat > 2.5:
                columns.append(fid)
    
    # Add interaction terms for top drivers
    products = []
    for i, d1 in enumerate(drivers):
        for j, d2 in enumerate(drivers[i+1:], i+1):
            col1 = feats.column(d1)
            col2 = feats.column(d2)
            # Check if interaction term would be useful (correlation < 0.6)
            corr = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, col1], feats.x[:, col2])[0, 1]
            if abs(corr) < 0.6:
                products.append((d1, d2))
    
    # Compute loadings for weighted score
    loadings = {}
    for fid in columns:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        # Weight by effect size (t-statistic)
        mean_diff = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, col_idx]) - np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, col_idx])
        t_stat = abs(mean_diff) / (np.std(feats.x[:, col_idx]) + 1e-8)
        loadings[fid] = t_stat
    
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple(drivers),
        columns=tuple(columns),
        products=tuple(products),
        loadings=loadings
    )
